You can build TERMINAL UIs using standard HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript?!?

Hello to TermDOM, a wild new project from the creator of Crank.js that puts a real DOM, a real cascade, and a real layout engine right inside your terminal!

If you can write a basic webpage, you can now build interactive CLIs, forms, and games (it even runs Solitaire!) using flexbox, standard DOM events, and custom elements.

See how it works: https://bit.ly/4zsZShp
